I replied to Hollis in the DM. I told him his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Corvid rollout is now Mondays at 13:45, and that I took no other action, as he asked.

I also told him I don't have private memory for each person, so that DM thread is the only record of this. I said I'd keep it to his DM and not repeat it anywhere else, and offered to set up a recurring calendar event if he wants one.
